FAQ.title:
HAVE A QUESTION?
WE'RE HERE TO HELP.
FAQ.description: Browse our most frequently asked questions to find quick answers. For advanced technical support, our experts are always a click away.
FAQ.a1: Orders inside Baghdad are delivered within 24 hours, while delivery to other provinces typically takes 2-3 days.
FAQ.q2: Are your products new or used?
FAQ.a2: All our products are 100% brand new and genuine from the manufacturer.
FAQ.a3: We offer a 1-year official warranty on most laptops and PC components.
FAQ.q4: What are the available payment methods?
FAQ.a4: Cash on delivery, cash at our store when you pick up, or electronic methods (ZainCash, Qi Card, Visa, Mastercard) as agreed on WhatsApp — the site does not auto-charge your card.
FAQ.a5: Products can be returned or exchanged within 30 days provided they are in their original unopened condition.
